function.name: transferir_fondos
function.description: This tool allows users to transfer funds from their wallet to a contact or wallet they provide. They can transfer to a phone number (same-chain) or to a wallet address on another network (cross-chain). They need to specify the amount, recipient, token type, and optionally the destination network and token.

to.description: Recipient: a wa_id (phone number) for same-chain transfers, or a wallet address for cross-chain transfers (EVM 0x address, Solana base58 address, or Bitcoin address).

token.description: Name of the token the user wants to transfer.

destination_token.description: Token symbol on the destination chain if different from source token. Omit to keep the same token.

network.description: Destination network for cross-chain transfers. Use the chain key (e.g., 'eth', 'arb', 'pol', 'sol', 'btc'). Omit for same-chain transfers.

no_pending.es: No hay una operación pendiente para validar.
no_pending.pt: Não há nenhuma operação pendente para validar.

expired.en: Verification expired. Please retry the operation.

max_attempts.en: Maximum attempts reached. Try again later.
